title: Packaging Lab
summary: YTIntel now turns verified winner-vs-control research into original title, thumbnail and opening-hook packages instead of stopping at analysis.
discord_changes: Builds 3–5 original title + thumbnail + hook packages from verified Radar research.
Uses GPT-5.6 Sol to compare winner patterns against controls and source thumbnails.
Adds evidence gating, copy-risk checks, falsifiers and a concrete test plan for every package.
changes: Added a new top-level Packaging Lab that consumes the latest Opportunity Radar evidence.
Added a new server-side GPT-5.6 Sol packaging action with strict structured output and max reasoning.
Added winner-versus-control packaging analysis so common style is not mistaken for a winning mechanism.
Added multimodal thumbnail evidence from verified winners and controls.
Added 3–5 ranked original packages containing title, alternate titles, thumbnail composition, opening hook and viewer promise.
Added evidence-fit, novelty, clarity, replication and package decision scores that are explicitly not view or CTR predictions.
Added browser-side source-title overlap detection to flag copy risk even after the model response.
Added an evidence gate requiring multiple verified winners across independent channels before strong packaging recommendations are generated.
Added originality delta, risk, falsifier and test-plan fields to every package so weak ideas can be killed before production.
Added copyable package briefs and local Packaging Lab history.
Refreshed the PWA cache so installed copies receive v0.12.1 automatically.
why_it_matters: YTIntel now closes another major gap between research and execution: verified competitor evidence can become an original production-ready package without silently copying the winner or treating a one-off breakout as proof.
